canonicalBasis: CPF_FINAL_TARGET_REQUIREMENTS.md section 4.4 excludes general Health/Actuator endpoints from business System6.
Management endpoints retain Spring Security, validation and the remaining servlet filter chain.
rootCause: The mandatory CpfWebContextFilter had no path boundary and invoked the external business Header adapter for every servlet request.
design: Configured management.endpoints.web.base-path and PathMappedEndpoints roots define the boundary.
Non-root base paths match exact base/descendants; root base paths match only Boot-discovered endpoint roots.
Servlet context path is removed before matching.
Adjacent prefixes such as /actuatorx or /managex remain business-filtered.
next: Exact Java 25 boundary regression, Fresh rebuild, then headerless Health and missing-header business-path runtime checks.
